nodes.name: orgs.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the org/team hierarchy data model (OrgDefinition, OrgMember, hierarchy modes, plan-approval policy) and the AgentOrgsStore responsible for loading, persisting, and validating orgs, including default SDE/DS template teams.

nodes.name: orgs_store
nodes.summary: Returns the process-wide lazily-initialized AgentOrgsStore singleton used to access org/team definitions.

nodes.name: parse_cli_agent_org_reference
nodes.summary: Parses a CLI-style agent id string to extract an org/team reference (org name and optional member path), if the id follows the CLI org-reference convention.

nodes.name: apply_overrides_to_member_tree
nodes.summary: Recursively walks an org member tree applying launch overrides (e.g., model, workspace) to matching members and their descendants.

nodes.name: apply_overrides_to_members
nodes.summary: Applies a set of member launch overrides to a flat list of org members, tracking which member ids were successfully matched.

nodes.name: ensure_default_template_team
nodes.summary: Ensures the default template team orgs (e.g. SDE, DS) exist in the store, creating or refreshing them if missing or stale.

nodes.name: ensure_default_org
nodes.summary: Generic helper that ensures a given default org exists and is up to date, using the provided builder and staleness-check closures.

nodes.name: default_sde_template_team_is_current
nodes.summary: Checks whether an existing SDE (software engineering) template org matches the current default template shape, to decide if it needs regeneration.

nodes.name: default_sde_template_team
nodes.summary: Builds the default 'SDE' template org, a preconfigured hierarchy of software-engineering agent roles.

nodes.name: default_ds_template_team_is_current
nodes.summary: Checks whether an existing DS (data science) template org matches the current default template shape.

nodes.name: default_ds_template_team
nodes.summary: Builds the default 'DS' (data science) template org, a preconfigured hierarchy of data-science agent roles.

nodes.name: load_from_disk
nodes.summary: Loads the orgs store contents from a JSON file on disk, returning the deserialized set of org definitions.

nodes.name: save_to_disk
nodes.summary: Serializes and writes the current org definitions to disk at the given path.

nodes.name: HierarchyMode
nodes.summary: Enum describing how an org's member hierarchy is structured (e.g., flat vs. nested reporting lines).

nodes.name: PlanApprovalPolicy
nodes.summary: Enum/struct describing the plan-approval policy for an org (e.g., who must approve a plan before execution), with an as_wire() conversion for the frontend.

nodes.name: OrgMemberRuntimeConfig
nodes.summary: Runtime configuration overrides for an individual org member (e.g., model, workspace, tool selection) applied at launch time.

nodes.name: OrgMemberLaunchOverride
nodes.summary: Represents a single launch-time override targeted at a specific org member or subtree.

nodes.name: OrgMember
nodes.summary: Represents one member (agent) within an org hierarchy, including its role and nested sub-members.

nodes.name: OrgDefinition
nodes.summary: Top-level org/team definition containing the member hierarchy, hierarchy mode, and plan-approval policy, with helpers to count members recursively.

nodes.name: AgentOrgsStore
nodes.summary: In-memory store for all org/team definitions, providing CRUD (insert/replace/remove), persistence, agent-reference validation, and launch-override application.

nodes.name: store.rs
nodes.summary: Implements AgentDefinitionsStore, the persistence layer that loads/saves agent definitions and override deltas to disk, composes builtins with overrides, and migrates legacy workspace settings.

nodes.name: definitions_store
nodes.summary: Returns the process-wide lazily-initialized AgentDefinitionsStore singleton.

nodes.name: migrate_legacy_workspace_settings
nodes.summary: Migrates legacy on-disk workspace-settings JSON shapes into the current agent-definition schema during load.

nodes.name: migrate_stale_summary_max_tokens
nodes.summary: Migrates stale/legacy summary-max-tokens configuration values found in persisted definitions to the current schema.

nodes.name: load_from_disk
nodes.summary: Loads the full set of agent definitions from disk, applying legacy migrations as needed.

nodes.name: save_to_disk
nodes.summary: Serializes and writes the current set of agent definitions to disk.

nodes.name: load_overrides_from_disk
nodes.summary: Loads the persisted override-delta file (user customizations layered on top of builtin agent definitions) from disk.

nodes.name: compose_builtin_with_delta
nodes.summary: Composes a builtin agent definition with a stored override delta to produce the effective definition for that id.

nodes.name: delta_against_builtin
nodes.summary: Computes the override delta between an effective (current) agent definition and its builtin baseline, for persistence.

nodes.name: save_overrides_to_disk
nodes.summary: Serializes and writes the override-delta map to disk.

nodes.name: AgentDefinitionsStore
nodes.summary: In-memory store for all agent definitions (builtin + overrides), providing CRUD, snapshotting, overlay updates, builtin reset, and disk persistence.

nodes.name: file_reinjection.rs
nodes.summary: Extracts recently-read files from conversation history and re-injects file-reference reminders into the message stream after compaction to preserve file-awareness.

nodes.name: extract_recently_read_files
nodes.summary: Scans recent messages for file-read tool results and extracts the set of file paths that were recently read, to preserve file-awareness across compaction.

nodes.name: is_excluded_from_reinjection
nodes.summary: Determines whether a given file path should be excluded from post-compaction reinjection (e.g., binary files, excluded directories).

nodes.name: message_text
nodes.summary: Extracts plain text content from a message's value/output representation.

nodes.name: truncate_at_boundary
nodes.summary: Truncates file content to a maximum byte size at a safe character boundary, avoiding mid-character splits.

nodes.name: build_file_reinjection_messages_with_preserved_tail
nodes.summary: Builds the set of synthetic reminder messages that re-inject recently-read file references after compaction, while preserving the untouched message tail.

nodes.name: reinject_files_after_compaction
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that reinjects recently-read file reminders into the compacted message history based on what was read before compaction.

nodes.name: file_registry.rs
nodes.summary: Maintains a registry of active session files on disk, supporting registration, unregistration, listing, and cleanup of stale session entries.

nodes.name: register_session
nodes.summary: Registers a new active session in the on-disk session registry, recording its metadata for crash-recovery/cleanup purposes.

nodes.name: unregister_session
nodes.summary: Removes a session's entry from the on-disk session registry once it has ended.

nodes.name: list_registered_sessions
nodes.summary: Lists all sessions currently recorded in the on-disk registry.

nodes.name: cleanup_stale_sessions
nodes.summary: Removes registry entries for sessions that are no longer active, given the current set of active session ids.

nodes.name: SessionRegistryEntry
nodes.summary: A single entry in the session registry file, recording a session's id and associated metadata (e.g., process/workspace info).

nodes.name: extract.rs
nodes.summary: Extracts durable session-memory content from conversation history via an LLM side-query, deciding when extraction should run and finding a safe extraction boundary.

nodes.name: should_extract
nodes.summary: Decides whether session-memory extraction should run now, based on current token usage, prior state, and whether the last turn has pending tool calls.

nodes.name: extract_session_memory
nodes.summary: Drives LLM-based extraction of durable session-memory content from the conversation, issuing a side-query to the given provider/model.

nodes.name: find_last_safe_boundary
nodes.summary: Finds the latest message index that forms a safe extraction boundary (not splitting a tool-call/tool-result pair).

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the core crate that re-exports config, coordination, definitions, interaction, model_context, providers, session, side_query, tools, and turn_executor submodules.

nodes.name: config.rs
nodes.summary: Defines default configuration structs (SessionMemoryConfig, SessionMemoryCompactConfig) controlling thresholds for the session-memory compaction feature.

nodes.name: SessionMemoryConfig
nodes.summary: Top-level configuration for the session-memory feature (extraction thresholds, enablement), with defaults.

nodes.name: SessionMemoryCompactConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration specific to session-memory-driven compaction (keep ratios, boundaries), with defaults.

nodes.name: learnings_lookup.rs
nodes.summary: Resolves accumulated learnings text for a given agent/session context, providing a small lookup helper used during agent definition resolution.

nodes.name: resolve_learnings_for
nodes.summary: Resolves the accumulated learnings text applicable to a given agent id by looking up stored learnings entries relevant to that agent.
